rule: Unique ID in format P0001 to P0500
Specific university course or course-level context
The actual educational task that both prompt versions must accomplish
example: Explain the four principles of OOP

rule: Explicit university-learning context establishing why this task is included
example: Student preparing for a university OOP final examination

rule: Intentionally inefficient or unoptimized version of the prompt
example: Explain Object Oriented Programming in extreme detail including...

rule: Optimized version targeting the same underlying task
example: Explain the four OOP principles for a university final exam answer

rule: Important elements expected in a satisfactory answer; separate multiple elements with semicolons
Relative path to external material when the task requires a paper code file or assignment material
Identifier or name of team member who created the task
Identifier or name of team member who reviewed the task
